title: 第17章 双生联盟第18章 星痕争夺战序幕
lines: 洛晖冲下议事厅石阶，星炎徽章被他塞进内甲暗扣。旧矿坑货单贴在胸口，纸背余热隔着衣料顶着皮肤。
绮兰跟在他身侧，礼裙外披了一件短斗篷，镶星晶手套已经扣紧。
“每次都这样。”她抬手扫开挡路的铁卫巡灯，“绮雯一出事，你跑得比暗鹰还快。”
洛晖翻过议事厅外侧护栏，落在下方窄巷。
“你也没慢。嘴上嫌弃，脚下挺诚实。”
绮兰踩着契约光阶落地，手套光纹乱跳两下，又被她按住。
“我去，是防止她把你卖进暗教祭坛。”
洛晖回头看她一眼，扔出显曜给的学院追踪符。
蓝色符片贴住巷口石墙，墙面浮出一条细路线，避开铁卫主街，直指北外环废墟。
“她要卖我，也得先排队。长夏，商会，皇族保守派，暗教都拿了号。绮雯现在插队，属于扰乱市场秩序。”
绮兰抬手把一枚银紫契约印按在他肩后。
“少贫。显曜说过，暗星印记核心与王血之门地脉同频。强剥会反噬。你用原初星纹压制，厄迦残留意志也会锁你。”
“锁就锁。”洛晖拉紧短披风，“今晚先把人抢回来。”
两人沿外环窄巷急行。曜都深夜被铁卫封锁线切成数段，街口黑钢拒马横在石路上，暗鹰机械翼停在钟楼高处，鹰腹晶眼扫过屋顶。
洛晖抬手，星痕流转贴地铺开。蓝火沿排水槽钻出去，烧断三枚追踪符外层。
绮兰随即挥指，绮氏契约微光盖住巷口晶眼。晶眼转动两圈，只捕到一片空白墙面。
“长夏的人已经动了。”绮兰收回手，“暗鹰搜索方向，也指向北外环。”
“那就跑快点。”洛晖跃上废弃货梯，“别让铁卫抢到她掌心那东西。到时候长夏拿着暗星印记上议事厅，一开口就是洛晖勾连暗教，证据确凿，建议剥纹，顺便把早餐也剥了。”
“你还有心思开玩笑？”
“不开玩笑会更烦。”
废墟区近了。
旧月钟塔倒塌在半截街墙上，塔顶铜钟裂成两片。钟塔下方，灰黑石柱围成祭坛，柱面刻满献祭咒纹。中央血池早已干涸，池底残留暗紫火星。
黑星火在血池里翻滚。
绮雯站在祭坛中央，黑银短发被火浪掀起。右腕暗星印记外层裂开，暗紫纹路顺着小臂往上爬。她左手握着暗影之刃，刃心那缕蓝色净火微微跳动。
石柱缝隙里，黑火凝成一张裂口。
“少主，回到祭坛。”
绮雯抬刀，刀锋贴上手腕外环。
“少主这称呼，留给你们新招的倒霉蛋。”
第一刀落下。
暗紫火焰从印记里喷出，缠住她手臂。皮甲被灼出裂纹，血滴入血池，池底暗门纹路亮起。
黑火裂口扩大。
“绮氏不要你。学院审你。洛晖只会把你当毒棋。”
绮雯反手一刀斩断黑火锁链。
“暗教把我养成刀，没教过刀会转刃？”
第二刀划下。
外层暗星印记崩开一半。血池暗门里爬出一具具灰影，胸口灰烬星纹自行拼合，四肢残缺，动作却快。
洛晖冲上祭坛外围。
“暗教审美真省钱。废墟，血池，破柱子，一套模板用十年，厄迦报销单都懒得换吧？”
绮兰从另一侧落地，契约光网瞬间张开，罩住三根石柱。
“闭嘴，专心。”
洛晖掌心蓝金星火贴地横扫，先焚掉外围暗鹰追踪符，再切断祭坛外圈三处供能纹。灰影扑来，他左手星火乱舞炸开，蓝金细刃穿过灰烬星纹，把第一排残影砸回血池边缘。
content_en:
Luo Hui rushed down the stone steps of the meeting hall, and the Star Flame badge was stuffed into his inner armor and buckled secretly. The old mine cargo bill was stuck to his chest, the residual heat from the back of the paper pressing against his skin through the fabric of his clothing.
Qilan followed beside him, wearing a short cloak over her formal dress, and her star crystal-encrusted gloves had been fastened.
"It happens every time." She raised her hand and swept away the patrol light blocking the way. "When something happens to Qiwen, you can run faster than Dark Eagle."
Luo Hui climbed over the guardrail outside the conference hall and landed in the narrow alley below.
"You're not slow either. You say you're disgusting, but you're honest with your feet."
Qilan stepped on the contract light steps and landed. The light patterns on her gloves jumped twice before being held down by her again.
"I'm going to prevent her from selling you into the altar of the Dark Cult."
Luo Hui looked back at her and threw out the academy tracking charm given by Xian Yao.
The blue talisman sticks to the stone wall at the entrance of the alley, and a thin line emerges from the wall, avoiding the main Tiewei Street and pointing directly to the ruins of the North Outer Ring.
"If she wants to sell me, she has to queue up first. Changxia, the Chamber of Commerce, the royal conservatives, and the secret sect have all taken the numbers. Qiwen is jumping in line now, which is disrupting the market order."
Qilan raised her hand and pressed a silver-purple contract seal on the back of his shoulder.
"Young Master. Xian Yao said that the core of the Dark Star Mark is at the same frequency as the King's Blood Gate. Forcibly stripping it will backfire. If you use the original star pattern to suppress it, the remaining will of Erga will also lock you."
"Just lock it." Luo Hui tightened his short cloak, "Get the person back tonight first."
The two of them walked quickly along the narrow alley of the outer ring. Yaodu was cut into several sections by the iron guard blockade late at night. The black steel barricades were lying on the stone road at the street intersection. The mechanical wings of the dark eagle were parked high on the bell tower, and the crystal eyes of the eagle's belly swept across the roof.
Luo Hui raised his hand, and the star marks spread out on the ground. The blue fire went out along the drainage channel and burned the outer layers of the three tracking charms.
Qilan then waved her finger, and the dim light of Qi's contract covered the crystal eyes in the alley. The crystal eye turned twice and only caught a blank wall.
"Changxia's people have already moved." Qilan retracted her hand, "The Dark Eagle search direction is also pointing to the North Outer Ring."
"Then run faster." Luo Hui jumped onto the abandoned freight elevator, "Don't let the iron guard grab the thing in her palm. When the time comes, Chang Xia goes to the meeting hall with the dark star mark. The first thing he says is that Luo Hui is in cahoots with the dark sect. The evidence is conclusive. He recommends peeling off the lines and peeling off the breakfast by the way."
"Do you still have the heart to joke?"
"It would be more annoying if I didn't joke."
The ruins area is near.
The Old Moon Bell Tower collapsed on half of the street wall, and the bronze bell on the top of the tower split into two pieces. Below the bell tower, gray and black stone pillars surround the altar, and the pillars are engraved with sacrificial incantations. The central blood pool has long since dried up, leaving dark purple sparks at the bottom.
Black Starfire rolled in the blood pool.
Qiwen stood in the center of the altar, her short black and silver hair lifted by the waves of fire. The outer layer of the dark star mark on the right wrist cracked, and dark purple lines climbed up the forearm. She held the Shadow Blade in her left hand, and the blue pure fire at the center of the blade beat slightly.
In the gap between the stone pillars, black fire condensed into a crack.
"Young Master, return to the altar."
Qiwen raised the knife and pressed the blade against the outer ring of her wrist.
"This title of Young Master is reserved for you new unlucky recruits."
The first knife fell.
Dark purple flames erupted from the mark and wrapped around her arm. Cracks appeared in the leather armor, blood dripped into the blood pool, and the lines on the hidden door at the bottom of the pool lit up.
The black fire crack widened.
"Qishi doesn't want you. The academy will examine you. Luo Hui will only treat you as a poisonous chess piece."
Qiwen cut off the black fire chain with a backhand knife.
"The secret sect raised me as a swordsman, but didn't he teach me how to turn a sword?"
The second slash was made.
The outer dark star mark collapsed in half. Gray figures crawled out of the secret door of the blood pool. The ashes and stars on their chests formed on their own. Their limbs were missing, but their movements were fast.
Luo Hui rushed to the outside of the altar.
"The aesthetics of the Dark Cult really save money. Ruins, pools of blood, broken pillars, one set of templates lasts for ten years, and Erga doesn't even bother to replace them when he pays for it, right?"
Qilan landed from the other side, and the contract light net instantly opened, covering the three stone pillars.
"Shut up and focus."
The blue and gold sparks in Luo Hui's palm swept across the ground, first burning the outer Dark Eagle tracking talisman, and then cutting off the three energy supply patterns on the outer circle of the altar. The gray shadow rushed towards him, and the sparks in his left hand exploded. The thin blue-gold blade passed through the ash star pattern, and smashed the first row of afterimages back to the edge of the blood pool.
title_en: Chapter 17 Twin Alliance Chapter 18 Prelude to the Battle for Star Marks
